knowledge:
- key_parameters: accumulation(acctype="TF"|"region"|"base", chr="chromosome_name"|"all", w=half_width_of_window) ;; dense_zones(threshold_step=integer_step, writeBed=logical) ;; high_accumulation_zones(method="binding_regions"|"overlaps", threshold="std"|"top_perc", k=integer, writeBed=logical, plotZones=logical)
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: When analyzing ChIP-seq data of transcription factor binding regions to identify genomic regions with high co-localization of different transcription factors.
- pitfalls: The "binding_regions" method in high_accumulation_zones requires the accumulation vector to be calculated with w=0. Calculation time of the accumulation vector increases significantly with larger values of w. acctype="base" has a higher running time than "TF" or "region", especially for chromosomes with many input regions. n_zones_PCA requires the number of different threshold values used in dense_zones to be identical across all three accumulation types.

workflows.name: tfhaz_analysis
workflows.intent: Find and analyze transcription factor high accumulation DNA zones from genomic coordinates of TF binding regions.
input: tf_regions.GRanges (GRanges object containing genomic coordinates of TF binding regions and TF names in metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate TF accumulation along the chromosome bases using accumulation ;; 2. Plot the accumulation vector using plot_accumulation ;; 3. Find dense DNA zones across multiple thresholds using dense_zones ;; 4. Plot the number of dense zones across thresholds using plot_n_zones ;; 5. Analyze the effect of window size w using w_analysis ;; 6. Perform PCA on different accumulation types using n_zones_PCA ;; 7. Identify final high accumulation zones (TFHAZ) using high_accumulation_zones
workflows.code:
data("Ishikawa")
dim(as.data.frame(Ishikawa))
head(Ishikawa)

TF_acc_21_w_0 <- accumulation(Ishikawa, "TF", "chr21", 0)

plot_accumulation(TF_acc_21_w_0)

TF_dense_21_w_0 <- dense_zones(TF_acc_w_0, 1, chr = "chr21")
TF_dense_21_w_0

plot_n_zones(TF_dense_w_0, chr = "chr21")

l <- list(TF_dense_w_10, TF_dense_w_100, TF_dense_w_1000, TF_dense_w_10000)
w_analysis(l, chr = "chr21")

n_zones_PCA(TF_dense_w_10, reg_dense_w_10, base_dense_w_10, chr = "chr21")

TF_acc_21_w_0 <- accumulation(Ishikawa, "TF", "chr21", 0)
TFHAZ_21_w_0 <- high_accumulation_zones(TF_acc_21_w_0, method = "overlaps",
threshold = "std")
TFHAZ_21_w_0
